presets.name: VA system delivery (example)
presets.description: A configurable review aid for one release of one made-up system. The checks are examples, not a list of artifacts every release must produce. A reviewer decides whether each check applies; a relevant artifact that is missing stays an evidence gap.

presets.name: SSA benefit statement review (example)
presets.description: One check for one made-up beneficiary-year: is a benefit statement expected, and is a reference to it on file. Applicability is decided per case by a reviewer. Nothing here calculates tax or decides tax treatment or eligibility.

sources.title: SSA - Get tax form (1099/1042S)
sources.scope: Public SSA statement about benefit tax forms, including that a person whose only SSA payment is SSI is not issued one. It says nothing about how staff review or retain statements, and nothing about whether a benefit is taxable.

presets.name: Public sector records (general example)
presets.description: A general starting point for documenting and scheduling records in a public sector office: an inventory, an owner for each record, a schedule reference, and a hold review. The expected record types are examples drawn from two government-wide schedules. It is a review aid; it does not decide which schedule applies or what must be kept.

sources.title: GRS 1.1 item 010 - Financial transaction records (official record)
sources.locator: General Records Schedule 1.1, Transmittal 31 (April 2020), item 010; disposition authority DAA-GRS-2013-0003-0001
sources.scope: Government-wide disposition item for the official record held in the office of record: 6 years after final payment or cancellation, with longer retention allowed for business use. It excludes contractor-maintained records and agency-unique mission records. Whether it applies to a particular record is for the organization's records officer; that is not decided here.

sources.title: GRS 3.1 item 011 - System development records
sources.locator: General Records Schedule 3.1, Transmittal 30 (November 2019), item 011; disposition authority DAA-GRS-2013-0005-0007
sources.scope: Government-wide disposition item for a type of record. It does not cover system data or content and does not require any record to be created. Whether it applies to a particular record is for the organization's records officer; that is not decided here.

sources.scope: Federal regulation on identifying and maintaining records. It applies to federal agencies and prescribes no checklist for this product. Material whose record status is unclear is treated as a record.

sources.title: 36 CFR part 1226 - Implementing Disposition
sources.scope: Federal regulation on applying approved schedules. It applies to federal agencies. It does not say which schedule covers a given record, and it does not use the term litigation hold.
